arabic text: NANHA MERA ASGHAR KAHAN GAYA RE\nBANU PUKARI KOOK JALI
english translation text: The sun has set and the lamp is lit. Where\nhas my little Asghar gone? Bano cried out, her heart burning.

arabic text: RAAT ANDHERI SUNSAN BAN\nDHONDOON KAHAN TUJHE AY GULBADAN\nRO RO PUKARI MAA DIL JALI
english translation text: The night is dark and the wilderness silent.\nWhere shall I search for you, O flower-bodied child?\nThe grieving mother called while weeping.

arabic text: WAQTE MADAD HAI MUSHKIL KUSHA\nMUSHKIL KARO HAL BEHRE KHUDA\nTUMHI BATADO MOULA ALI
english translation text: O Remover of Difficulties, this is the hour of need.\nFor God's sake, remove this hardship.\nYou alone can tell me, Maula Ali.

arabic text: JUNGLE MAY KISJA TU KHOGAYA\nKHAALI HAI JHOOLA AY MEHLEKHA\nKISKO JHULAYE AMMA TERI
english translation text: Where in the wilderness have you become lost?\nThe cradle is empty, O moonlike child.\nWhom will your mother now rock?

arabic text: AREY YE TO BATADE AY HURMALA\nCHEDA HAI KYUN TUNE NANHA GALA\nDOOBI HAI KHOON MAY NANHI KALI
english translation text: Tell me, O Hurmala:\nwhy did you pierce that tiny throat?\nThe little flower is submerged in blood.

arabic text: TERI ZAMEEN PAR AY KARBALA\nGUM HOGAYA HAI BACHA MERA\nDHOOND RAHI GALI GALI
english translation text: O Karbala, upon your earth\nmy child has become lost.\nHis mother searches from lane to lane.

arabic text: DUKHYARI MAADAR JAYE KAHAN\nVEERAN LAGTA HAI SAARA JAHAN\nKARTI HUVI AAHO-ZAARI CHALI
english translation text: Where can this grieving mother go?\nThe whole world appears desolate.\nShe walks onward, crying and lamenting.
